picture_rules: Use only the committed dated site/docs PNGs, original site hero-loop MP4 and two dated Decisions WebMs as page imagery. Slides summarize checked r4 facts; rendering must not capture a browser or imply a new live call.
The landing and docs are still images. Editorial crop, push-in and highlight are allowed, but must not resemble a native scroll, click or page transition.
Only the two Decisions WebMs contain recorded page interaction: expanding Inspect evidence on a read-only public page. Those clicks did not create a payment or run a model.

Keep the separate executed r4-16 refusal, saved r4 model B purchase and checked report, and separate r4-17/r4-18 direct retry visibly labeled. The first proof montage changes its source label at every cut.
Slides use the existing AgentTrust paper, ink and violet visual language, with precise data and no generic robot or blockchain imagery.
The Decisions final payment view has no transaction hash or checked HTTP report. Pair it with the existing r4 docs still and a sourced receipt slide for those claims.

shots.source_label: DATED PUBLIC SITE CAPTURE / NATIVE NEAR
shots.narration: We built AgentTrust for the moment an AI agent wants to spend. The owner names exact suppliers, required capabilities and limits. The agent receives a narrow payment tool.
shots.avoid: Do not animate a website scroll, click Read the Quickstart or open the private GitHub CTA. The page does not perform payments.

The original hero loop moves within the matching site region; no scroll or click is simulated.

shots.narration: The test owner trusts two exact service identities, requires an invoice.audit.v1 credential from an accepted issuer, and caps each purchase. The worker key can call only execute_payment.
shots.layout: Warm-paper editorial slide: first reveal A+B exact service identities, invoice.audit.v1 and accepted issuer; then reveal the 0.01 NEAR session purchase cap; finally reveal Owner → Native core ← restricted worker key with execute_payment only.
shots.motion: Reveal identity and credential conditions from the first sentence, purchase cap as spoken, and worker authority path on the final sentence. No approval switch or reputation score.

shots.narration: In our saved local-model run, five tool requests are recorded. The model reads policy and supplier details, then asks to pay A. The host previews MISSING; no transaction is sent.
shots.claim_limit: These are dated documentation stills of a saved self-recorded local trace, not footage of a new model call. The A preview has no transaction and is distinct from executed direct r4-16.

shots.narration: Only after settlement does B release its report. Of 15 synthetic invoice rows, eight pass and seven fail. It catches a negative amount on row nine and duplicate invoice A-100. A separate checker verifies this fixed report.
shots.layout: Typeset checked synthetic report on warm paper. The input excerpt shows rows 01–02 as duplicate invoice A-100, then row 09 negative -0.01 USD. The report side reveals 15 rows, 8 accepted and 7 rejected, verified against the fixed input.
shots.motion: Duplicate excerpt is present first; 15-row count appears, then the 8 accepted / 7 rejected split in sync with the spoken line. Negative row follows; the fixed-input checker note appears last.
shots.claim_limit: This is a controlled synthetic-input result, not evidence of general invoice-audit accuracy.
